			}

			}
		}

			}

				not_parameter = government_is_tribal

			}
			province_government_modifier = {

			}
		}

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_income_tier_5
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_income_tier_5_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_furs
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_meat_production_add = smokehouse_meat_output_per_furs_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_woodland_tax_per_furs_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_woodland_tax_per_furs_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_meat_production_mult = smokehouse_meat_mult_per_salt_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_woodland_tax_per_salt_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = smokehouse_woodland_tax_per_salt_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_meat CATEGORY = trade_category_meat }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_furs }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_salt }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_cured_meat_producer_modifier = { VALUE = ai_building_priority_soft }
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_meat CATEGORY = trade_category_meat }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}

}
